record.prompt: Coherent WHOLE FOUR-VIEW repaint of the supplied NEW fictional ERWIN ARCHIV miniature character source. This is a benign style/proportion correction of Image1, not a change of identity. Preserve Image1's elderly round face, neat short GREY BEARD, round spectacles, sparse short grey hair, weary gentle eyes, charcoal textured cardigan with tan elbow patches, ochre collared shirt, grey trousers, broad tan walking shoes, and tied bundle of blank cream folders held by anatomical LEFT forearm/hand. Original source is too long below the head. Match Image2 canonical Heiko/Inga/Schwabingen miniatures: markedly larger expressive head, SHORT stout torso and SHORT substantial legs, TOTAL standing height approximately2.2–2.3head heights. Head including hair about44% of whole figure. Preserve age/mature identity. Repaint connected head-neck-shoulder, torso, pelvis, arms, knees and ankles coherently across ALL four views; no detached enlarged head, no vertical squashing or independently resized pieces. Same family proportions, consistent foot baseline, same bodily scale and same prop hand in front/right/rear/left. ONE horizontal row, FOUR columns: FRONT neutral, true RIGHT-facing PROFILE, true REAR (no face), true LEFT-facing PROFILE. In RIGHT profile the actual right near hand is EMPTY and left-owned folders sit on the FAR forearm, naturally partially occluded near the front edge. In LEFT profile folders are on the near actual left forearm. Rear folders remain actual left side. Complete readable connected hands and broad full shoes, no clipping, generous transparent gutters. All visible lips clean CLOSED rest crease under moustache/beard, no open oral cavity. Painterly soft warm shaded volumes and clear dark contour matching canonical city miniatures; no realistic long limbs. Fully TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no scenery/ground/shadows/grid/labels/text/watermark. Do not add or remove clothing, spectacles, beard or folders; do not invent extra props or actions.
